entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA1727 analyzer opt-in to allow OTel dotted.lower.case attribute names in log message template #50807
  • Support -e (--environment) in dotnet test for MTP #50806

PullRequests

Created

  • Ensure file-based apps' csc uses correct dotnet #50811
    Area-run-file
  • Support env variables for dotnet test (MTP) #50810
    Area-dotnet test, Area-dotnet test (MTP)
  • Simplify reading process stdout/stderr for dotnet test [MTP] #50808
    Area-dotnet test, Area-dotnet test (MTP)
  • [dotnet test MTP] Separate evaluation parallelization level from running test apps #50805
    Area-dotnet test, Area-dotnet test (MTP)

Updated

  • Add feature-level telemetry for dotnet run command #50793
    Area-Infrastructure, Document for new feature, Area-Telemetry
  • feature: Add analysis for camel-cased format arguments in LoggerMessageAttribute #50766
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add --test-runner option to global.json template #50757
  • File-based apps: consider args in simple csc optimization #50779
    Area-run-file
  • Dotnet watch browser refresh configurable port #50629
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-Watch
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50648
  • Fix confusing environment option help text in dotnet run command #50795
  • Add --no-logo as a synonym for --nologo #50705
  • Fix RunReadyToRunCompiler to use ItemSpec instead of ToString for assembly references #50791
